SET @prov_c := '%s';

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);

  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	monthly	varchar(2) NOT NULL,
total int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d5 int(10) DEFAULT 0,

d29 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d30 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
d31 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,monthly),
	KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,monthly),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year),
	KEY (monthly)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_jdisease1;
CREATE TEMPORARY  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_jdisease1  (
PRIMARY KEY (HOSPCODE,PID,DATE_SERV),
KEY (HOSPCODE,PID,DATE_SERV),
KEY (HOSPCODE)
) ENGINE=MyISAM  DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE AS
SELECT
HOSPCODE,PID,DATE_SERV
,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,1) ORDER BY SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,1)) as g_diagcode
FROM tmp_jdisease j INNER JOIN chospital h ON j.hospcode=h.hoscode
AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15)  
WHERE SUBSTR(DIAGCODE,1,1) in('J','B','U')
GROUP BY HOSPCODE,PID,DATE_SERV
ORDER BY HOSPCODE,PID,DATE_SERV;

DELETE FROM s_j_disease1 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_j_disease1
(SELECT 
  @id,h.HOSCODE,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%m') mm
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(g_diagcode) >1	,CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid),NULL )) total
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_serv,'%d') IN(1) AND (LENGTH(g_diagcode) >1 OR INSTR(g_diagcode,'U'))

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("total") as "total" ,SUM("d1") as "d1" ,SUM("d2") as "d2" ,SUM("d3") as "d3" ,SUM("d4") as "d4" ,SUM("d5") as "d5" ,SUM("d6") as "d6" ,SUM("d7") as "d7" ,SUM("d8") as "d8" ,SUM("d9") as "d9" ,SUM("d10") as "d10" ,SUM("d11") as "d11" ,SUM("d12") as "d12" ,SUM("d13") as "d13" ,SUM("d14") as "d14" ,SUM("d15") as "d15" ,SUM("d16") as "d16" ,SUM("d17") as "d17" ,SUM("d18") as "d18" ,SUM("d19") as "d19" ,SUM("d20") as "d20" ,SUM("d21") as "d21" ,SUM("d22") as "d22" ,SUM("d23") as "d23" ,SUM("d24") as "d24" ,SUM("d25") as "d25" ,SUM("d26") as "d26" ,SUM("d27") as "d27" ,SUM("d28") as "d28" ,SUM("d29") as "d29" ,SUM("d30") as "d30" ,SUM("d31") as "d31"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
